description: This file contains utility functions for handling currency formatting and conversions in the frontend of a software project. It includes functions to format a numeric amount into a localized currency string and to convert USD amounts into other currencies using static exchange rates.

methods.name: formatMoney(amount, currency)
methods.description: Formats a numeric amount into a localized currency string using Intl.NumberFormat, with fallback to a string with two decimal places if Intl is unsupported.

methods.name: convertFromUsd(usd, currency)
methods.description: Converts a USD amount into another currency (EUR or GBP) using simple static exchange rates. Returns the original amount if the target currency is not recognized.
